HOST portrait: Strice Foods Host — a corporate Matrix system rendered as cyberspace architecture, NOT a person and NOT a creature. Strice Foods is a mid-tier Seattle food corporation running a deliberately low-cost system (Orange-4). Sculpt it as a cold industrial food-processing plant reimagined in the Matrix: monolithic vats, conveyor lines and silo forms built from luminous wireframe and grid-mapped planes, receding into black void. A corporate logo motif glows at the centre like a system core. Sterile, cheap, functional — the digital equivalent of a cannery, not a glamorous megacorp cathedral. Palette: cold steel and grey-green with amber warning glow; avoid purple.
